1. (Currently amended) A method of analyzing one or more plant embryos comprising: (a) collecting shed cellular material from one or more plant embryos by agitating the one or more embryos in a non-destructive aqueous medium; (b) obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material; (c) performing a molecular analysis of the DNA obtained in step (b); and (d) germinating at least one of said one or more embryos.

2. (Original) The method of claim 1 wherein the non-destructive medium consists essentially of water.

3. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the DNA is obtained by exposing the shed cellular material to cold followed by heat and then agitation.

4. (Currently amended) The method of claim 3 wherein said cold, heat, and agitation steps are performed in a sequential manner and are repeated.

5. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the DNA is obtained by heating the shed cellular material in an aqueous medium followed by agitation.

6. (Currently amended) The method of claim 5 wherein said heat and agitation steps are repeated.

7. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein DNA is obtained by incubating the shed cellular material with an enzyme that degrades cell walls.

8. (Original) The method of claim 7 wherein the enzyme is VISCOZYME@.

9. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material comprises extracting the DNA using a suitable extraction technique.

10. (Currently amended) The method of claim 9, wherein said extracting is performed by adding magnetic particles to the shed cellular material to facilitate DNA separation.

11. (Original) The method of claim 1 wherein the one or more embryos comprise one or more immature embryos.

12. (Original) The method of claim 1 further comprising storing the one or more embryos prior to step (c) or (d).

13. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein said molecular analysis is genotyping using a variety of techniques.

14. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13, wherein said genotyping occurs by way of: single nucleotide polymorphism detection, restriction fragment length polymorphism identification, random amplified polymorphic detection, amplified fragment length polymorphism detection, DNA sequencing, whole genome sequencing, allele specific oligonucleotide probes, or DNA hybridization to DNA microarrays or beads.

15. (Original) The method of claim 1 further comprising growing a germinated embryo into a plant and phenotyping the plant.

16. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein prior to said molecular analysis, a whole genome amplification is performed to increase the DNA yield.

17. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13 further comprising selecting one or more embryos based on genotype analysis.

18. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17 further comprising germinating the one or more selected embryos based on their genotypic characteristics.

19. (Currently amended) The method of claim 18 wherein any of the steps resulting in selection of one or more embryos is semi-automated or fully automated.
